linesContent.text: Splits off 50% of the weapon's bodyshot damage into an Explosive Payload that detonates on impact.
The Payload deals 30% increased damage in PvE and staggers PvE Combatants more.
On Hand Cannons, the Payload deals 7% decreased damage in PvP.
The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.
[PvE] Total damage is increased by 15% of the weapon's bodyshot damage. For crits, the overall increase is roughly equal to 15% divided by the Crit Multiplier.
[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.
Passively grants 5 Reload Speed.
Splits off 55% of the Weapon's Bodyshot damage into a Explosive Payload that detonates after a 0.6 second delay. The Payload deals 30% increased damage in PvE and staggers PvE Combatants more.
The remaining Impact damage portion receives an increased Crit Multiplier to compensate for the Payload not benefitting from crits.
[PvE] Total damage is increased by ~16.5% of the weapon's Bodyshot damage. On Crits, the overall increase is 10.9% for Adaptive/Precision Hand Cannons and 10.17% for Aggressive Hand Cannons.
[PvP] Total damage remains roughly the same but can vary by 1-2% in either direction for crits.
